api/src/jobs/platform/__init__.py.name: Platform jobs package
api/src/jobs/platform/__init__.py.description: Groups the long-running platform operations that survive restarts and report their progress.

api/src/jobs/platform/application_deploy.name: App build and release
api/src/jobs/platform/application_deploy.description: Builds a standalone app and switches it live in one step, or leaves the previous version running.

api/src/jobs/platform/application_publis.name: App publishing
api/src/jobs/platform/application_publis.description: Publishes a finished app so it becomes available to the people it is shared with.

api/src/jobs/platform/application_sdk_up.name: App toolkit rebuild
api/src/jobs/platform/application_sdk_up.description: Rebuilds one app on the current app toolkit and makes the result live without touching anything else.

api/src/jobs/platform/audit_archive.py.name: Audit log archiving
api/src/jobs/platform/audit_archive.py.description: Moves older audit history into verified long-term storage, either on request or on a timetable.

api/src/jobs/platform/audit_query.py.name: Audit history export
api/src/jobs/platform/audit_query.py.description: Exports archived and current audit history into one file for an administrator.

api/src/jobs/platform/base.py.name: Platform job contracts
api/src/jobs/platform/base.py.description: Defines how a long-running platform task reports failure, waits for a person, or hands off to outside work.

api/src/jobs/platform/catalog.py.name: Platform job catalog
api/src/jobs/platform/catalog.py.description: Lists every long-running platform task, what it needs and how it should be run.

api/src/jobs/platform/embedding_reindex..name: Search index rebuild
api/src/jobs/platform/embedding_reindex..description: Rebuilds the search index for knowledge documents so search results become accurate again.

api/src/jobs/platform/file_move.py.name: Moving files in the background
api/src/jobs/platform/file_move.py.description: Moves or copies files between folders reliably, including many at once and name clashes.

api/src/jobs/platform/git_operation.py.name: Workspace Git actions
api/src/jobs/platform/git_operation.py.description: Runs a requested Git action on the workspace, such as pulling or pushing changes.

api/src/jobs/platform/kubernetes_client..name: Hosted job client
api/src/jobs/platform/kubernetes_client..description: Talks to the hosting platform to start, watch and stop build jobs, and to report when memory ran out.

api/src/jobs/platform/kubernetes_runner..name: Hosted job entry
api/src/jobs/platform/kubernetes_runner..description: Runs one long platform task inside its own dedicated hosted machine.

api/src/jobs/platform/policy.py.name: Platform job policies
api/src/jobs/platform/policy.py.description: Holds the simple rules that say how a long-running task may be run and retried.

api/src/jobs/platform/registry.py.name: Job handler list
api/src/jobs/platform/registry.py.description: Finds the handler for a requested long-running task only at the moment it is needed.

api/src/jobs/platform/reimport.py.name: Workspace reimport
api/src/jobs/platform/reimport.py.description: Reloads the workspace's saved files after an outside change so the platform sees the current version.

api/src/jobs/platform/run_retention.py.name: Old run cleanup
api/src/jobs/platform/run_retention.py.description: Deletes finished runs and their events once they pass the retention window, on request or on a timetable.

api/src/jobs/platform/runner.py.name: Platform job runner
api/src/jobs/platform/runner.py.description: Runs one claimed long platform task in a separate process so a failure cannot harm the server.

api/src/jobs/platform/solution_deploy.py.name: Solution install
api/src/jobs/platform/solution_deploy.py.description: Installs or updates a packaged Solution, whether starting fresh or upgrading an existing install.

api/src/jobs/platform/solution_export.py.name: Solution backup
api/src/jobs/platform/solution_export.py.description: Produces a backup copy of a Solution that can be stored or shared.

api/src/jobs/platform/solution_git_sync..name: Solution Git update
api/src/jobs/platform/solution_git_sync..description: Pulls the latest changes for a Solution that is connected to a Git repository.

api/src/jobs/platform/summary_backfill.p.name: Summary backfill
api/src/jobs/platform/summary_backfill.p.description: Re-summarises a chosen set of past agent runs and tracks the whole batch to completion.

api/src/jobs/platform/system_maintenance.name: Nightly upkeep
api/src/jobs/platform/system_maintenance.description: Runs the recurring housekeeping: refreshing sign-ins, renewing message subscriptions, checking updates and clearing old files.

api/src/jobs/platform/video_generation.p.name: Video generation
api/src/jobs/platform/video_generation.p.description: Creates a video from a prompt in the background and stores it for the person who asked.

api/src/jobs/platform/workspace_bundle_i.name: Solution archive import
api/src/jobs/platform/workspace_bundle_i.description: Imports a reviewed Solution archive into the shared workspace.
